parameters.name: FileId
parameters.description: The ID of the file. You can call [ListFiles](~~173942~~) to query the file ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Used for paging.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the small wrench icon in the upper-right corner of the page to go to the storage management page and view the ID.

parameters.name: ProjectIdentifier
parameters.description:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the English identifier displayed in the workspace switcher at the top of the DataStudio page.

You must set either this parameter or ProjectId to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call.
